question: Using Section 7B.05 and Figure 7B-2, describe the required sign sequence for entering and leaving a reduced school speed-limit zone.
model_answer: Direct Answer: Entering the zone, a School (S1-1) sign must first be installed in advance, followed by the School Speed Limit assembly (or S5-1 School Speed Limit When Flashing sign) placed at or as near as practicable to the point where the reduced school speed limit zone begins. If an optional Reduced School Speed Limit Ahead (S4-5) sign is used, it must be followed by the School Speed Limit sign or assembly. Leaving the zone, the downstream end must be marked with an END SCHOOL SPEED LIMIT (S5-3) sign (with a limited exception allowing an END SCHOOL ZONE alternative per Paragraph 4). Standards (mandatory): - "A School Speed Limit assembly (see Figure 7B-1) or a School Speed Limit When Flashing (S5-1) sign (see Figure 7B-1) shall be used to indicate the speed limit where a reduced school speed limit zone has been established... The School Speed Limit assembly or School Speed Limit When Flashing sign shall be placed at or as near as practicable to the point where the reduced school speed limit zone begins (see Figures 7B-2 and 7B-4)." - "If a reduced school speed limit zone has been established, a School (S1-1) sign shall be installed in advance (see Table 2C-3 for advance placement guidelines) of the first School Speed Limit sign assembly or S5-1 sign that is encountered in each direction as traffic approaches the reduced school speed limit zone (see Figures 7B-2 and 7B-4)." - "Except as provided in Paragraph 4 of this Section, the downstream end of an authorized and posted reduced school speed limit zone shall be identified with an END SCHOOL SPEED LIMIT (S5-3) sign (see Figures 7B-1, 7B-2, and 7B-4)." - "If used, the Reduced School Speed Limit Ahead sign shall be followed by a School Speed Limit sign or a School Speed Limit assembly." - "The static School Speed Limit assembly shall consist of a top plaque (S4-3P) with the legend SCHOOL, a Speed Limit (R2-1) sign, and a bottom plaque (S4-1P, S4-2P, S4-4P, or S4-6P) indicating the specific periods of the day and/or days of the week that the special school speed limit is in effect (see Figure 7B-1)." - "If a school zone has been designated under State or local statute, a School (S1-1) sign (see Figure 7B-1) shall be installed to identify the beginning point(s) of the designated school zone (see Figure 7B-2)." Visual evidence: - [Image 1] Figure 7B-2 illustrates the full sequence in each direction of travel: an advance School (S1-1) sign (with optional SCHOOL S4-3P plaque), an optional Reduced School Speed Limit Ahead (S4-5) sign, the School Speed Limit assembly (SCHOOL S4-3P plaque, SPEED LIMIT 20 R2-1 sign, and S4-1P time-period plaque) at the zone beginning, and an END SCHOOL SPEED LIMIT (S5-3) sign OR END SCHOOL ZONE (S5-2) sign—each optionally paired with a SPEED LIMIT 45 (R2-1) sign—at the downstream end. - [Image 2] Figure 7B-1 shows the components of the School Speed Limit assembly (S4-3P SCHOOL plaque over an R2-1 sign over an S4-1P, S4-2P, S4-4P, or S4-6P plaque), the S5-1 School Speed Limit When Flashing sign, the S4-5 advance sign, and the S5-2/S5-3 end-of-zone signs. - [Image 3] Page 1019 contains the Section 7B.05 Standard text governing the placement of the assembly, the advance S1-1 sign, and the S5-3 end sign. - [Image 5] Page 1016 is the full page view of Figure 7B-2 showing the example school zone signing layout. - [Image 6] Page 1020 (Figure 7B-4) shows an analogous entering/leaving sequence for a school zone with higher fines for speeding, confirming the same S1-1 → S4-5 → School Speed Limit assembly → S5-3/S5-2 pattern. Citations: - Section 7B.05 Standard §1 (p.978) - Section 7B.05 Standard §2 (p.978) - Section 7B.05 Standard §3 (p.978) - Section 7B.05 Standard §14 (p.980) - Section 7B.05 Standard §7 (p.980) - Section 7B.02 Standard §4 (p.972) - Figure 7B-2 (p.975) - Figure 7B-1 (p.973) - Page 1019 - Page 1016 - Page 1020
gold_answer: Approaching traffic first encounters an advance School (S1-1) sign, then the School Speed Limit assembly or S5-1 at the beginning of the reduced zone. The downstream end is normally marked by S5-3 END SCHOOL SPEED LIMIT; S5-2 END SCHOOL ZONE may be used when both zones end together, with a downstream R2-1 optionally mounted.
